_comment: Reference copy of this Lambda's execution-role policy, for human review outside Terraform HCL. The live resource is terraform/iam.tf's aws_iam_role_policy.lambda_auto_shutdown — keep both in sync if either changes. Source: ceiba_aws_deployment_strategy.md §5.2, tightened 2026-07-28 (ec2:StopInstances scoped to the one instance, not account-wide '*' — see docs/ or the fix/infra-apply-blockers branch that made this change).

Statement._comment: The live Terraform resolves this to aws_instance.app.arn directly at apply time. This placeholder form is shown here only because a static JSON reference file can't run Terraform interpolation.
ec2:DescribeInstances genuinely does not support resource-level permissions - '*' is correct and required here, not a scoping gap.
